advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Update the mcp deploy log line to report the actual range ($mcp_deployed -> $TARGET) it diffs, not $DEPLOYED -> $TARGET.
evidence: 651: if changed_range "$mcp_deployed" "$TARGET" "$MCP_PATHS"; then
652:   log "mcp sources changed $DEPLOYED -> $TARGET; blue-green deploy ..."
The gate diffs $mcp_deployed..$TARGET but the log prints $DEPLOYED..$TARGET — divergent since the whole point of mcp_deployed is that it can differ from DEPLOYED.
advisory.finding: The mcp deploy log line reports the range as `$DEPLOYED -> $TARGET`, but the gate and actual diff now use `$mcp_deployed -> $TARGET`. When mcp is behind its own marker but the global DEPLOYED equals TARGET (e.g. mcp lagged during a prior deferral episode that later completed), the log claims 'mcp sources changed $DEPLOYED -> $TARGET' with identical endpoints, misdescribing the deploy that is actually happening and obscuring the real range during incident triage.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test covering an absent/unparseable MCP_SHA_FILE so the mcp_deployed->$DEPLOYED fallback (first-tick-after-landing behavior) is actually exercised.
evidence: 1011:   rev-parse) cat "__TARGET_FILE__"; exit 0 ;;
autodeploy.sh:510-513: mcp_deployed=$(cat MCP_SHA_FILE); if [ -z ... ] || ! git rev-parse --verify ...; then mcp_deployed=$DEPLOYED
ABSENCE: no new test seeds an absent or garbage MCP_SHA_FILE and asserts mcp still deploys off $DEPLOYED — the fallback branch is untested.
advisory.finding: The git stub's `rev-parse` case unconditionally `cat`s __TARGET_FILE__ and exits 0, so the mcp_deployed marker-validity guard (`git rev-parse --verify -q "$mcp_deployed^{commit}"`) always succeeds in tests regardless of the marker's content. The new tests therefore never exercise the fallback-to-$DEPLOYED path for an absent/unparseable MCP_SHA_FILE, leaving the 'first tick after this lands decides exactly as today' guarantee unverified.
